entries.name: Tool-Local Compact Discipline Codes
entries.scope: May be used only where an explicit tool instruction defines the local naming surface; not valid as enterprise/container identity codes.

entries.name: Legacy / Candidate Sheet Series Codes
entries.scope: May be considered only by a lower-precedence simplified sheet-numbering profile after the authority resolver establishes that no higher-precedence convention governs.
entries.decision_note: D-18/D-19 are suspended as universal TIVERIT defaults. International, authority, client, project-information-standard, BEP, and governed-CDE requirements resolve first.

resolved_conflicts.resolution: 3-4 letter discipline codes govern enterprise/container identity; compact codes remain valid only in explicitly governed tool-local naming contexts.

A TIVERIT sheet-series convention shall not override applicable international, authority, client, project, BEP, or governed-CDE numbering requirements. Candidate series values remain available only for a future simplified fallback profile.

provenance.curator_note: Sheet-series treatment updated after international/Middle-East/Aconex authority research; no external standard text is reproduced here.
